summary: Master Governance Strategy with ISO 37000 and COSO ERM. Align board oversight with ESG and risk management. Enroll now for expert-led training.
lede: Governance strategy for executives and boards provides a structured way to connect board oversight, executive decisions, and operational reality. This course moves beyond passive, check-the-box compliance by building practical capability in COSO ERM risk oversight, incentive alignment, ESG reporting, succession planning, and ethical digital transformation. You will practise board evaluation techniques and learn to design a board skills matrix, construct a risk appetite statement, and implement a stakeholder engagement plan for investors and regulators. Grounded in the ISO 37000 governance of organizations standard, the course also introduces board portal technologies to streamline decision-making and support high-performance oversight amid limited time, complexity, and technological change.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for high-level decision-makers and those who support the governance function at the highest levels of the organization.
modules: Risk Governance and COSO ERM Integration
Financial Oversight and Audit Committee Excellence
Ethics, Culture, and the Tone at the Top
Stakeholder Engagement and Activist Investor Defense
prerequisites: Participants should hold a senior management or board-level position or be preparing for such a role. A foundational understanding of financial reporting and organizational structure is required. No specific legal background is necessary, as the course focuses on international governance frameworks rather than local statutes.
